title: Refused issue deletion exits nonzero
description:
Deleting an issue without the confirmation environment variable prints a refusal and exits 0, so scripts treat the refusal as success. Hit live during tracker hygiene: a cleanup step believed a deletion had happened when it had not.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: A deletion refused for missing confirmation exits nonzero (invalid-argument family, exit 2) in both text and JSON modes.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: Under --json the refusal emits the structured error envelope with a distinguishing code and the confirmation hint in suggestions.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: A confirmed deletion's exit code and output are unchanged.
